$comment: Taste findings accepted on purpose; `bun harness/taste.ts scan` leaves them out. One entry per finding: page (the scan's page name: home, player, about, ...), id (the check id), selector (exactly as findings.json prints it) and reason (why it stays: the repo rule it follows, or why the checker misreads it). Example: {"page": "player", "id": "collide", "selector": "div.stage-controls", "reason": "AGENTS.md: the floating UI draws over the lyrics"}
